Read AGENTS.md and the issue's relevant skill. Preserve the headless architecture, deterministic simulated time, externally visible bus effects, and side-effect-free inspection. Every functional change needs deterministic tests. Include hardware sources and commands/results in the PR. Use a dedicated issue branch and keep the issue open for owner merge. For review, inspect the current commit independently against the acceptance criteria. Report actionable findings with severity, location, impact, and verification. Do not fix findings in the review role.
